name: Rami Levy Hashikma Real Estate Ltd
summary: Rami Levy Hashikma Real Estate Ltd operates as a real estate development and investment company in Israel. It operates in two segments, the real estate investment sector; and the development and establishment of residential construction projects. The company was formerly known as Rami Levy Marketing Shekma Ltd and changed its name to Rami Levy Hashikma Real Estate Ltd in October 2024. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Jerusalem, Israel. Rami Levy Hashikma Real Estate Ltd is a subsidiary of RL Holdings Limited.
